reason: The enzyme label says it helps clotting proteins form threads, directly matching the remaining goal.

reason: The story says the threads reinforce the platelet plug, so bringing them together should help stop the leak.

reaction: The difference between sealing the vessel and healing the skin was interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the protein threads to the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the two parts work together to stop bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the initial cut was straightforward and less interesting than seeing how the leak was stopped.

surprise.text: The damaged vessel narrowed but was still leaking, and the skin remained open even after bleeding stopped.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary: the story and pictures explained the pairings.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the open skin heals, since stopping the bleeding was only the first repair.
